welcome.transcript: Pick a road, then drive from the shining number.

nudge.transcript: Oops, a little off-road. Follow the white dashes.

all-done.transcript: Peep, peep! You drove every letter road!

cruise-intro.transcript: drive each easy road from start to finish.

prompt-l.transcript: Start at the star, drive down, then across.

done-l.transcript: Lovely driving! You made the letter L!

prompt-u.transcript: Drive down, curve around and drive back up.

done-u.transcript: Up! You go! You made the letter U!

prompt-c.transcript: Start at the top, drive around the big curve.

done-c.transcript: Cool curve! You made the letter C!

prompt-o.transcript: Drive left around the whole loop.

done-o.transcript: Oh, what a loop! You made the letter O!

town-intro.transcript: Drive the numbered roads in order.

prompt-a.transcript: Drive Road 1, Road 2, then the little bridge.

done-a.transcript: Amazing! You built the letter A!

prompt-t.transcript: Drive across the top, then down the middle.

done-t.transcript: Terrific turns, you built the letter T.

prompt-h.transcript: Down one side, down the other, then cross the bridge.

done-h.transcript: Happy Honk! You built the letter H!

prompt-k.transcript: Drive down, then make the two slanting roads.

done-k.transcript: Keep on cruising! You built the letter K!
